promises.quote: We have reviewed and updated the ESNEFT Morphine Administration Guideline and the Naloxone Administration Guideline in line with those set out in the British National Formulary (BNF).
promises.summary: Updated morphine guideline to align with BNF

concerns.quote: staff on the ward (whether doctor or nurse) were not familiar with either the national morphine guidelines (BNF) or indeed those of the hospital
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness of morphine guidelines

concerns.quote: hospital's own Serious Incident report had incorrectly quoted the hospital's guidelines as to the safe dose of IV morphine
concerns.hazard: incorrect safe dose of IV morphine quoted in report

concerns.quote: adequacy of education re safe morphine doses that newly qualified doctors and locum doctors receive, and how this is audited
concerns.hazard: inadequate education and audit of safe morphine doses for new doctors

concerns.quote: hospital's own guidelines regarding morphine administration for acute pain management have not been revised since 2013 and are at odds with the current BNF guidelines
drug charts design did not facilitate clear instructions for titration for one-off doses of IV morphine
concerns.hazard: poor drug chart design for IV morphine titration

concerns.quote: nurse did not feel confident enough to challenge the prescription (as she perceived it) effectively or escalate / refer to another doctor
concerns.hazard: nurse's lack of confidence to challenge prescription

reports.title: David Fenn: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Signs of sepsis where not appropriately recognised and the Sepsis 6 Pathway was not followed
concerns.hazard: sepsis not recognised and Sepsis 6 pathway not followed

concerns.quote: An early Consultant [name redacted] was not sought
The later attempt to seek the Consultant's views was hampered by the use of a mobile phone which had poor signal in the operating theatre and crucial information was not fully imparted/understood
concerns.hazard: communication breakdown due to poor mobile signal

concerns.quote: The junior doctor did not feel able to challenge the view of the Consultant to discharge nor did they seek to reapproach them with fuller information
concerns.hazard: junior doctor reluctance to challenge consultant

concerns.quote: An alternative Consultant's opinion was not sought
concerns.hazard: failure to obtain alternative consultant opinion

concerns.quote: The Multi Disciplinary Team meeting the following morning did not discuss Mr [name redacted] case when it should have
